Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Small documentation fixes are welcome.
Link a related issue if there is one; no issue is required for a clear fix.

**Validation**
Commands run and their results; name any checks you could not run.

      wallet files, or unredacted sensitive logs are included.

- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.

For security concerns, use [private reporting](https://github.com/OakAgentKit/oak/security/advisories/new).
